verdict.rationale: Lever documents a public REST API (applications, audit events, webhooks, OAuth) at hire.lever.co/developer/documentation, showing a genuine documented API surface for programmatic/agentic access. However, evidence is limited to a list of endpoint/topic names with no independent/hands-on corroboration, no mention of rate limits, SDKs, or agent-friendly features. Missing for 10: independent verification of API usability, broader endpoint coverage details, and evidence of AI-agent-specific tooling or SDKs.
